subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which open raw-payload normalization branch should become the canonical landing path after proof and serialization blockers are addressed?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same source-proven bug, and automation cannot safely choose between the smaller branch and the broader sibling while proof remains gated.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the landing candidate only if it adds total serialization, a non-JSON regression, and accessible live proof.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 if maintainers prefer its after-middleware/extension normalization shape once proof and CI are reviewable.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 if maintainers prefer its after-middleware/extension normalization shape once proof and CI are reviewable.
